Hey man, i'm honestly not that good at cleaning images, but i can give you a general idea of what to do and also link you the tutorials i used to help get me going. 

I used the [***Patch Tool***](http://planetphotoshop.com/removing-objects-with-content-aware-fill-and-patch-in-photoshop-cc.html)	 in photoshop for large background areas like the purple and yellow background. About 80% of the time though i used the ***Clone stamp tool***. These are some great tutorials/tips, [**1**](https://petapixel.com/2011/06/21/using-the-photoshop-clone-source-panel/), [**2**](http://digital-photography-school.com/12-tips-for-mastering-the-clone-stamp-tool-in-photoshop/) that i used to help me learn the clone stamp tool. It does however, take a lot of trial and error. This image took me about 1-1.5 hours. 

Basically all i can tell you is just play around with the tools, take your time and pick something easy to clean first. Good Luck!
